gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu has tall-bodied small letters and curves that gape open, a friendly, modern face under Joystix's widely tracked arcade lettering. Bold up top, approachable below.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Joystix tracks its arcade letters far apart, with a faint crayon-on-rough-paper rhythm in its strokes. Noto Sans Lisu follows with wide-open s curves and almost no stroke contrast, so extended reading stays smooth and unfussy.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Joystix spaces its bold arcade letters far apart, with a moderate thick-thin ratio in the strokes. And Noto Sans Lydian, a plain sans with capitals barely taller than lowercase, keeps the text beneath it level and approachable.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Bold is the first thing Joystix gives you, its widely tracked letters carrying only a soft, understated shift in stroke thickness. But Noto Sans Mahajani is the surprise, a modern sans-serif whose lowercase stands tall against its capitals.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-malayala: Arcade swagger meets a quiet workhorse here. Joystix is best at wide-spaced, chunky display lettering, while Noto Sans Malayalam, a plain sans, is best at building a dense, approachable texture where the middle zone of the line dominates.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Bold arcade attitude comes from Joystix, its widely tracked letters showing medium contrast in the strokes. Noto Sans Mandaic, a plain sans with lowercase rising close to capitals, handles the quieter running text.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Joystix brings widely tracked arcade lettering, with sturdy downstrokes and slender turns in a comfortable contrast. Noto Sans Marchen takes over below, a clean sans whose small letters stand almost capital-sized and whose curves end in clear daylight.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-mayan-nu: Joystix lays out bold arcade letters with wide tracking and a modest, readable difference in weight across every curve. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals, with tall-bodied small letters, is the contrast.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-medefaid: Noto Sans Medefaidrin reads as a professional, contemporary sans-serif, its lowercase rising high and its curves turning in without any ink pooling. Joystix adds bold, widely tracked arcade lettering with mild contrast above it.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-meetei-m: Noto Sans Meetei Mayek has large lowercase eyes and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, a modern sans under the heading. Joystix brings the strongest quality, bold arcade lettering with stroke weights that differ just enough to feel alive.
